scenario: Time comparison operates on utc_us per LTIM.5.2. A rule with `a.fired_at > b.fired_at`, a Time > Time comparison across two patterns, compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no comparison is evaluated.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule r:
    Event a where a.entity_id == "a"
    Event b where b.entity_id == "b" and a.fired_at > b.fired_at
->
    log info "a is newer"
